item.title: Reopening of the Shrine of the Báb, Haifa - Bahá'í Gardens
item.description: The construction project at the Shrine of the Báb on Mount Carmel in Haifa is now completed. On Sunday, December 1st 2024, the Shrine and its surrounding gardens will be again open to the public.
